query:
SELECT
                m.text AS "text!: String",
                m.created_at AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
            FROM users u
            INNER JOIN messages m
            ON
                m.user_id = u.id
            WHERE
                m.chat_id = $2
                AND (u.username = $1 OR u.first_name = $1)
                AND m.text IS NOT NULL AND m.text <> ''
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
            LIMIT $3
